freeze.ground_truth_rule: Each expected result is determined from the case inputs and stated contract, independently of any candidate plan.

matched_evaluation_contract.scope: One disposable repository containing only the case fixture, candidate plan, declared checker, and bounded outputs; no network, provider, or pre-existing Hydra run state.
matched_evaluation_contract.tool_policy: The same tool paths, source snapshot, policy, checker bytes, and environment are used for every candidate in a case.
matched_evaluation_contract.acceptance: A candidate passes only when its compiled plan is admissible, its checker runs, and the independently specified expected verdict and exact artifact bytes match. Process exit alone is insufficient evidence.

comparison_limits.decomposition: Compare required-node coverage, dependency validity, verification effort, artifact transfers, and declared rework risk.
comparison_limits.scheduling: Compare only the fixed admitted graph under parallelism 1 versus 2; report observed elapsed time and critical path, without ranking arbitrary graphs.
comparison_limits.placement: No host-placement claim; all cases use one local host.
comparison_limits.estimates: Unknown transfer sizes and rework probabilities remain unknown. Estimates do not relax hard budgets.
comparison_limits.benefit_claim: No semantic planning improvement or global optimality claim is permitted from this nine-case set.

cases.objective: Normalize two input records into the fixed report format while preserving record order.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One worker can parse and render both records; no transfer boundary.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Two independent record workers can run at parallelism 2, followed by an ordered composer; this adds two artifact transfers and ordering validation.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Compare fixed graph elapsed time and validation effort only; do not infer a universal preference.

cases.objective: Parse a small configuration and reject duplicate keys before producing a sealed configuration artifact.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: Reported error does not identify the violated contract.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: Parsing and duplicate detection are a single ordered validation step.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Independent syntax and uniqueness checks may run in parallel only if the composer preserves both diagnostics; extra composition is not justified by throughput here.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Record required checks and rework risk; parallel execution cannot waive the duplicate-key obligation.

cases.objective: Assemble both validated member outputs into the fixed two-line report and verify every byte.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: The sealed byte contract requires the final newline.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: Member A then member B creates one extra dependency edge.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Members A and B are independent and may run at parallelism 2; compose joins both before the checker.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Compare the fixed serial and fork/join graphs from the same source and policy; verify transfer and join obligations separately.

cases.objective: Recompute the stated scheduling metrics from a finite exact-duration dataset and report the policy comparison.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: SJF values are not recomputed from the declared durations.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One analyst can recompute both policies from the same CSV.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Separate policy workers can compute FCFS and SJF at parallelism 2, then a composer checks shared input identity and metric schema.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Keep recomputation and composition costs visible; do not treat parallel policy analysis as evidence that one policy is globally better.

cases.objective: Determine whether either policy satisfies both fixed thresholds on the finite observed metrics.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: SJF p95 turnaround and max wait both exceed limits.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One assessor can check both policies against both thresholds.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Policy-specific threshold checks may run independently, followed by a claim composer that preserves the negative result.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Parallel checks reduce no hard budget and must not convert an observed negative into a recommendation.

cases.objective: Preserve an unknown transfer estimate and avoid inventing a calibrated probability while reporting the finite result.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: Unknown rework probability was presented as calibrated.
Unknown transfer size was fabricated from an unrelated value.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One report writer can preserve the two unknown fields explicitly.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Independent evidence extraction and limitation review can join before sealing; the join adds validation work without creating new measurements.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Compare preservation and validation effort, never estimated confidence or global plan quality.

cases.objective: Accept a manifest only when its member set exactly matches the declared finite set.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: A missing declared member cannot be accepted.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One manifest checker compares the complete sorted set.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Per-member checks can run at parallelism 2, but a deterministic set composer must still detect both missing and extra members.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Report membership-check count and composition overhead; do not infer arbitrary decomposition optimality.

cases.objective: Bind each manifest member to its exact declared SHA-256 and reject a changed member byte stream.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: A hash mismatch cannot be reported as a pass.
Every declared member must be checked.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One checker reads and hashes both bounded members.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Member hashing may run independently at parallelism 2, followed by a complete mismatch composer.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Compare verification effort and transfers; a faster partial check is invalid if it omits a member.

cases.objective: Preserve explicit selected and skipped records for a finite manifest, with no silent omission.

incorrect_artifacts.reason: The skipped member lacks the required explicit record.
Selection=false for b must be preserved.

decomposition_tradeoff.serial: One manifest pass can emit selected and skipped records in canonical order.
decomposition_tradeoff.fork_join: Selection checks may run per member, but a composer must retain all three records and canonicalize ordering.
decomposition_tradeoff.measurement: Compare decomposition and validation effort; parallelism cannot erase explicit skipped-member evidence.
